title: Core of the Desk Minimum and the New-Balance Test — Crestline Credit Card
content:
For the minimum the Crestline care desk takes on the latest Crestline Credit Card statement, the core of the minimum follows the statement's new balance: when the new balance is below the payment floor, the core is the whole new balance and it is the whole minimum, with nothing added to it and nothing taken off it but the payments made toward the statement since it closed; when the product's percentage of the new balance less the equal-payment balance at closing, rounded up to the whole dollar, is above the payment floor, the core is that rounded figure; otherwise the core is the payment floor.

**The equal-payment balance at closing** is the 24-month equal-payment plan's purchase amount less the payment allocations recorded for it and the merchandise credits on its ticket, with the allocations of payments made toward the latest statement added back. On an account without a 24-month equal-payment plan it is zero.

## Figures by product

| Product | Payment floor | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care Card Starter | 29 USD (29.0) | 3.5% |
| Crestline Auto Care Card | 30 USD (30.0) | 3.5% |
| Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred | 35 USD (35.0) | 3.25% |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard | 35 USD (35.0) | 3% |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | 40 USD (40.0) | 3% |
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | 40 USD (40.0) | 2.75% |

## Decision table

| Statement's new balance | Rounded percentage figure | Core |
|---|---|---|
| below the floor | — | the whole new balance, which is the whole minimum less only the payments made toward the statement since it closed |
| at or above the floor | above the floor | the rounded percentage figure |
| at or above the floor | at or below the floor | the floor |

## Cases (hypothetical, Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred: floor 35 USD, 3.25%)

- New balance 28.40 USD, 10.00 USD paid toward the statement since it closed: the minimum is 18.40 USD.
- New balance 2,611.40 USD, no equal-payment plan: 3.25 percent is 84.87 USD, rounded up to 85 USD, above the floor; core 85 USD.
- New balance 2,611.40 USD with an equal-payment balance at closing of 1,800.00 USD: 3.25 percent of 811.40 USD is 26.37 USD, rounded up to 27 USD, not above the floor; core is the floor.
